controls.label: Monochrome
controls.description: Cassini clear-filter imagery projected onto the measured irregular shape. Bounded correction reduces photographed shading; fine crater shadows remain. Coverage and resolution vary, and unavailable regions are marked.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Radius above a 135 km reference sphere from the Cassini stereo and limb shape model. This shows global relief and elongation, not a finely resolved terrain DEM; shape uncertainty reaches 6 km on the less-observed side.
